Walter Lini was an Anglican priest from Pentecost who led Vanuatu to independence in 1980 and served as its first prime minister until 1991.

His Vanuaʻaku Pati, mostly English-speaking, campaigned for land to return to its customary owners, a demand written into the constitution: only ni-Vanuatu can own land. He faced the Coconut War on Santo in his first months, and asked Papua New Guinea for troops to end it.

Lini preached Melanesian socialism and kept Vanuatu non-aligned, opening ties with Cuba and Libya and opposing French nuclear tests. He ended the condominium and is honoured as the father of the nation.
sum: Walter Lini was an Anglican priest from Pentecost who led Vanuatu to independence in 1980 and served as its first prime minister until 1991.
